label: Source: publicly available Azentio material (azentio.com)
usageRules: Only claims listed here may be used to describe Azentio or its products; cite their ids.
Claims are taken near-verbatim from azentio.com; do not add figures, customer names, outcomes or superlatives beyond the claim text.
Never discuss pricing, discounts, commercial terms, SLAs, uptime, guarantees, delivery timelines or other commitments; route those to a specialist.

claims.text: Azentio delivers purpose-built, intelligence-driven technology designed to transform banking, insurance, capital markets and ERP.
Azentio has deep experience in the BFSI and enterprise sectors across Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East, including local market dynamics and regulatory landscapes.
Azentio offers mission-critical software for financial institutions that is robust, secure and scalable.

lending_platform.name: Azentio Lending
lending_platform.summary: Future-ready digital lending suite for banks and NBFCs.

claims.text: Azentio Lending is a unified lending suite that helps banks and NBFCs achieve speed, scalability and policy adherence.
Azentio Lending streamlines loan origination, management and collections through intelligent automation, real-time insights and a robust decisioning engine.
Azentio Lending has built-in support for both conventional and Islamic finance.
Azentio Lending supports retail, SME and corporate lending segments.
Intelligent workflows and scoring models support quicker credit approvals.
Decisioning as a service provides a cloud-native decisioning engine with dynamic scoring and real-time approvals.
Azentio was recognized as a Category Leader in the Chartis RiskTech Quadrants for Credit Lending Operations Solutions 2026 report.
iMAL is an AAOIFI-certified core banking platform built specifically for Shari'ah-compliant finance.
iMAL covers retail, corporate, treasury, investment, trade finance and microfinance.
Every product and process in iMAL is Shari'ah-aligned by default.
iMAL is a modular, parameter-driven platform that helps banks launch new offerings quickly and expand into new markets.
iMAL is API-first and cloud-ready, integrating with mobile, online and open banking ecosystems.
iMAL provides end-to-end lifecycle management for Islamic financing products, covering origination, disbursement, repayments and collections.
Azentio iMAL was named Best Islamic Core Banking Software 2026 at the Global Islamic Finance Awards (GIFA).

aml_compliance.name: Azentio AMLOCK
aml_compliance.summary: AI-powered financial crime and compliance platform.

claims.text: AMLOCK is an AI-powered, all-in-one financial crime and compliance platform tailored for banks and financial institutions.
AMLOCK delivers an integrated approach to KYC onboarding, real-time screening, ongoing monitoring, regulatory reporting and investigations.
AMLOCK Advanced Analytics uses AI and machine learning on historical data and customer behavior to uncover hidden AML patterns and risks.
Automated alerts suppression filters irrelevant alerts so investigation teams can focus on high-risk cases.
AMLOCK screening checks prospects, customers and transactions in real time against sanctions lists, politically exposed persons, adverse media and other watchlists.
AMLOCK combines global coverage with local adaptability, with configurable solutions tailored to local regulations across multiple jurisdictions.
Azentio was named a Category Leader in the Chartis RiskTech AML Transaction Monitoring Solutions 2026 report for AMLOCK.

digital_banking.name: Azentio Digital
digital_banking.summary: Digital banking, onboarding and payments suite.

claims.text: Azentio's digital banking suite brings together Digital Banking, Digital Onboarding and Payments Hub.
Azentio Digital unifies multiple channels to provide a personalized, seamless digital experience for retail, corporate and investment banking.
